intro: Picture this: a small stay in the quiet Sattahip area, rooms with a private balcony to catch the breeze, a garden and a grilling corner for a BBQ with friends, and a few minutes' drive each morning to Dongtan and Nang Ram Beach with their clear water and white sand — Pob Choke Residences is a small stay in Sattahip District, Chonburi Province, positioning itself as a budget option for anyone who wants to explore the eastern coast in peace · It is a small place of around 15–20 rooms, each with AC, a fridge, a TV, and a private balcony · What real reviews keep mentioning are spacious clean rooms, comfortable beds, friendly staff, and a quiet location, plus a garden, a BBQ corner, free Wi-Fi, free parking, and a 24-hour front desk · It sits near Dongtan Beach, Nang Ram Beach, the Sea Turtle Conservation Center, and only about 13 km from U-Tapao Airport · From around THB 585/night, with an average score near 7.5 across review platforms.

body.html: Who Pob Choke Residences is for — to put it as simply as possible, Pob Choke Residences is a place for people who want to explore the Sattahip coast in a way that is quiet, simple, budget-friendly, and built around having your own car · It is not a beachfront resort with an infinity pool, nor a high-rise hotel on the main Pattaya road, but a small stay of around 15–20 rooms in the Sattahip area, simply and warmly furnished, leaning on cleanliness and a friendly feel rather than luxury · Sattahip itself is a small seaside town in Chonburi that still holds onto its community and naval-base character, unlike Pattaya with its crush of foreign tourists, which makes stays in this zone a good fit for anyone wanting to escape the bustle · Pob Choke Residences has a fairly clear stance: a budget stay where every room has a private balcony, with a garden and a grilling corner (BBQ) to relax with friends or family, sitting a short drive from Dongtan and Nang Ram Beach, known for the clear water and white sand of the Sattahip side · Real reviews (gathered from international platforms that average around 7.5) line up on the same point: the people who fit best here are couples wanting a quiet atmosphere, groups of friends who want to do a BBQ, and families driving down for a wallet-friendly beach trip, rather than those chasing nightlife, a wide range of big-hotel facilities, or a walk-to-the-sand location · You could say Pob Choke Residences plays the "quiet budget stay near the Sattahip sea" card fairly clearly, as long as you set your expectations to match the price.

Location and getting around — Pob Choke Residences is at 39/3 Moo 6, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province, in the zone near Dongtan Beach and Nang Ram Beach, two of the most popular beaches on the Sattahip side · The strength of the location is how close it is to the Sattahip sea — a short drive from Dongtan Beach (Ao Dongtan), known for clear water, white sand, and a calmer mood than Pattaya Beach; Nang Ram Beach, another popular beach inside the naval zone; and the Sea Turtle Conservation Center, an educational stop in the area · The neighborhood feels noticeably more relaxed and quiet than Pattaya Beach or Jomtien, because it is a town where locals and navy families actually live, not a purely tourist district · Distances are a bit longer: from the stay to Pattaya city and Walking Street is about a 40–50 min drive depending on traffic, to Nong Nooch Tropical Garden Pattaya about 20–30 min, and other spots within range such as Cartoon Network Amazone and Pattaya Dolphin World are a drive away · As for U-Tapao Airport (UTP), it is about 13 kilometers away, or roughly a 20–25 min drive, which is very convenient for anyone flying straight into U-Tapao · The honest caveat: the Sattahip area is easiest to get around with your own car or a rental, because public transport is not as dense as in Pattaya city, the stay is not right on the beach to walk to, and the shops and restaurants around it are not on every corner · Without a car you would lean on Grab or taxis, which can be hard to hail at times and add up in fare — this is worth weighing before you book.

"The room was bigger than I expected, clean, with a comfortable bed and a balcony to sit out and catch the breeze in the morning. The staff were friendly and looked after us well · It is quiet and peaceful, great for getting away from the bustle, but you should bring your own car because you have to drive to get anywhere."

Room types and decor — Pob Choke Residences is a small stay with only a handful of rooms, around 15–20 (the number varies slightly across booking platforms depending on the period) · The rooms are furnished in a simple, warm style that leans on being clean and practical rather than on luxury design · The signature touch is that every room has a private balcony to sit out and catch the breeze or have a morning coffee, and some reviews say it looks out onto the garden or open views of the area, easy on the eye · In-room amenities cover the standards for this level, including air conditioning, a fridge/minibar, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a shower, and bathroom amenities, plus free Wi-Fi · Many reviews agree that the rooms are bigger than expected, clean, and have comfortable beds, which is what makes them feel worth the budget price · To be straight about it, there are points worth knowing: some reviews mention the bedding being small separate blankets rather than a standard duvet, which not everyone is used to, and soundproofing that is only so-so because it is a small building, so you may hear some noise from neighboring rooms or outside · Details on room types and bed sizes are worth asking about and choosing carefully at booking time, especially if you are coming as a group or need an extra bed, because a small stay has only a few room types and limited availability.

Facilities, the garden, and the BBQ corner — the first thing to be clear about is that Pob Choke Residences is a small stay that sells quiet and a friendly feel above all, without a swimming pool or gym like a big resort, so if your main aim is the pool or a wide range of facilities, this place may not hit the mark · But what Pob Choke Residences does have, and does well, is its garden and grilling corner (BBQ), which is its own selling point — groups of friends or families driving down for the beach can buy fresh ingredients and seafood from Sattahip market and grill their own BBQ at the stay in a quiet garden setting, a charm you do not get at a typical chain hotel · On top of that there is a shared area to relax, free Wi-Fi throughout, free on-site parking, and a 24-hour front desk, handy for anyone arriving late or traveling by car · The biggest strength is still the quiet location and being a short drive from Dongtan and Nang Ram Beach, so you can use the stay as a base to head out to the sea and come back to rest in comfort · To be honest, the facilities here are the "small but just enough for a simple getaway" kind, with no pool, gym, or multiple dining zones like a large resort · But for people who come to sleep somewhere quiet, do a BBQ with friends, and head out to the beach during the day, what is here is enough and fits a budget-style break.

Food and dining around the stay — Pob Choke Residences is a small stay that does not focus on an in-house restaurant like a big hotel; the main booking platforms note that in-stay food options are limited, and some reviews mention that food is available but the menu is not varied, which is normal for a small place · What makes up for it is the BBQ corner and garden, where guests can bring their own ingredients to grill, so groups of friends and families can put together their own dinner in a relaxed setting · But the real star of this location is the fresh seafood of the Sattahip area, a short drive from the stay — both Sattahip market with fresh seafood at local prices, and the seaside seafood restaurants known for fresh catches and friendlier prices than the ones in Pattaya city · Sattahip town also has cafes, made-to-order eateries, and convenience stores within a short drive, a decent spread to choose from even if it is not on every corner like in Pattaya · The honest tip: if you want late-night snacks or specific supplies, stock up during the day, because shops in the area close earlier than in a tourist city · Overall, food is not a reason to come for the in-stay dining, but the real stars are the seafood and local restaurants of the Sattahip area all around, plus the BBQ corner you can do yourself at the stay.

Service — service is the point that earns fairly steady praise in real reviews of Pob Choke Residences · Because it is a small stay where the owner and team look after things closely, many reviews mention a friendly welcome and attentive staff who help recommend restaurants and sights and make the stay easy · Having a 24-hour front desk is also an advantage, handy for anyone arriving late at night by car or setting off early in the morning, which not every small stay offers · Being a small place turns into an advantage in that guests get personal attention, do not have to wait in a long queue, and feel relaxed, more like staying at a holiday home than checking into a big hotel · To be straight about it, the caveat worth knowing is that because the team is not large and there is no full-service system like a chain hotel, some services may need to be arranged in advance, such as ordering food, setting up the BBQ corner, or check-in/check-out timing · But overall the service at Pob Choke Residences is a point that helps hold the whole experience to a good standard among budget stays.

What real reviews say (praise and gripes) — gathered from booking platforms and review sites that average around 7.5 from dozens of guests, the picture is fairly consistent (the number of reviews is still not large because it is a small stay and some platforms do not have a score yet) · On the praise side: the most-mentioned point is spacious, clean rooms, with many reviews saying the rooms are bigger than expected for the price; next come comfortable beds, friendly, attentive staff, a private balcony with a nice mood to catch the morning breeze with some reviews praising the view from the balcony in the morning, and the quiet that really does let you escape the bustle of Pattaya · On the gripes side: the points mentioned are bedding being small separate blankets rather than a standard duvet that some are not used to, so-so soundproofing where you may hear some noise from neighboring rooms or outside, limited in-stay food options, and a location fairly far from the main sights that you have to drive to reach · You should also factor in the lack of a pool and that getting around is easiest with your own car · Most of these gripes can be managed by setting the right expectation that this is a small budget stay selling quiet and spacious clean rooms, not a resort selling a full set of facilities and a walk-to-the-sand location.

"Stayed with friends and grilling a BBQ in the garden was a lot of fun, the room was clean and spacious and the price was easy on the wallet · The only downsides are that you have to drive to get to the beach, and the in-stay food options are limited, but it is not far to drive into Sattahip town for seafood."

Price and value — the starting price of Pob Choke Residences is around THB 585/night in the normal range according to booking platforms, climbing during weekends or long holidays when people flock to the Sattahip coast · Compared with beachfront stays or resorts across the Sattahip–Bang Saray zone in general, this price sits in the easily affordable budget bracket and is good value for anyone who prioritizes a clean, quiet place to sleep over a beachfront spot or a full set of facilities · What makes it good value is staying in a room that many reviews call spacious and clean, with a private balcony, a garden and BBQ corner to use, free parking, and a 24-hour front desk · Compared with large beachfront resorts in this zone where the price jumps up several times over, Pob Choke Residences feels like a wallet-friendly option for people who use the stay as a base to sleep and then head out to the beach during the day · To be straight about it, the value depends on whether you have your own car, because the cost of getting to and from the beach and town by Grab can push the total higher if you do not · If you plan a simple getaway, drive your own car, do a BBQ with friends, and visit Dongtan and Nang Ram Beach, the money you spend at Pob Choke Residences buys back quiet and a spacious room that is worth it at this price · But if your main aim is nightlife in Pattaya city every day, you want a pool, or you want a walk-to-the-beach location, the mounting travel costs and the limits on facilities may bring the value down, so weigh it against the style of your own trip.

What to know before you book — a few things help make the stay smoother · One, this place is easiest with your own car or a rental, because the location is in an area where you have to drive out to the beach, restaurants, and sights, with free parking provided · Two, because it is a small stay with only a few rooms, it fills up fast on long holidays and weekends, so book ahead and compare prices across several platforms · Three, soundproofing is only so-so and the bedding is the small-blanket type, so if you are sensitive to noise or want a thick duvet, ask and prepare ahead · Four, there is no swimming pool here, so if the pool matters for this trip, consider another stay that has one · Five, if you want to use the BBQ corner and garden, arrange it with the stay in advance and plan to buy fresh ingredients and seafood from Sattahip market yourself · Six, because it is a small stay, in-stay food options are limited, so plan your meals mainly around the seafood and local restaurants of the Sattahip area, and buy late-night snacks to stock up during the day.

Bottom line — from all the real reviews, Pob Choke Residences is the best fit for people who want to explore the Sattahip coast in a quiet, simple, budget version, with their own car as a base, using the stay as a clean place to sleep plus a BBQ corner with friends · The rooms that many reviews call spacious and clean, the private balcony to catch the morning breeze, the garden and grilling corner, free parking, the 24-hour front desk, and the location a short drive from Dongtan and Nang Ram Beach give it its own charm among the budget stays of the area · But you have to accept, honestly, that this is a small stay with no pool, so-so soundproofing, small-blanket bedding, limited in-stay food options, and a location that is easiest with your own car · If you are looking for nightlife, a wide range of facilities, a pool, or a walk-to-the-beach location, this may not be the answer, and you should consider a resort or hotel in Pattaya city instead · But for a relaxing trip where you want to sleep somewhere quiet, drive around the Sattahip beaches, do a BBQ in the garden, and use the stay as a small base on an affordable budget — Pob Choke Residences answers that need simply and with good value, as long as you choose your room well and set the right expectations.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Pob Choke Residences

faq.q: Where is Pob Choke Residences · is it far from Pattaya city?
faq.a: The stay is at 39/3 Moo 6, Sattahip Subdistrict, Sattahip District, Chonburi Province, in the zone near Dongtan Beach and Nang Ram Beach · It is a short drive from Dongtan Beach, Nang Ram Beach, and the Sea Turtle Conservation Center · From Pattaya city and Walking Street it is about a 40–50 min drive, and only about 13 km from U-Tapao Airport (~20–25 min drive), convenient for anyone flying straight into U-Tapao.

faq.q: Who is Pob Choke Residences best for?
faq.a: It is a great fit for couples, groups of friends, and families driving down for a quiet, budget-friendly Sattahip beach trip · The highlights are spacious clean rooms, every room with a balcony, a garden and BBQ corner to grill, and free parking · If you focus on nightlife in Pattaya city every day, want a pool, or want a walk-to-the-beach location, a resort or hotel in Pattaya city may suit you better.

faq.q: What is the starting price of Pob Choke Residences · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at around THB 585/night for a standard room with a balcony in the normal range · It is a small stay with around 15–20 rooms, including larger rooms for 2–3 people and rooms for families/groups · Prices climb on weekends and long holidays, and rooms fill up fast because there are few of them, so book ahead and compare across several platforms.

faq.q: Does Pob Choke Residences have a pool and food?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool here; instead it sells quiet, spacious rooms, a private balcony, and a BBQ corner in the garden · As for food, it is available but with limited options, the menu not varied given the small size · The strength of the area is fresh seafood at Sattahip market and the seaside restaurants a short drive away, plus the BBQ corner where you can bring your own ingredients to grill.

faq.q: Do you need your own car to get to Pob Choke Residences?
faq.a: Not strictly, but your own car or a rental is easiest, because public transport in the Sattahip area is not dense and the location means driving out to the beach, restaurants, and sights · The stay has free parking · Without a car you would lean on Grab or taxis, so allow time and budget for travel, especially when heading into Pattaya city.

faq.q: Does Pob Choke Residences really have a usable BBQ corner · what is the bedding like?
faq.a: Yes, there is a garden and grilling corner (BBQ) where guests can bring their own ingredients to grill, great for groups of friends and families — we recommend arranging it with the stay in advance · As for bedding, some reviews mention it being small separate blankets rather than a standard duvet, which not everyone is used to, and soundproofing is only so-so · If you want a thick duvet or are sensitive to noise, ask and prepare in advance.
